```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
```


```{r}
fastani <- read_tsv('<PROJECT_ROOT>/Results/ANI/Rso_Genbank_complete/work/fastani_matrix.tsv')

metadata <- read_csv('<PROJECT_ROOT>/Results/Pangenome/FASTBAPS_CLUSTERS/RSSC-sensitive.fastbapsClusters.csv') %>% 
  rename("Genome" = "Isolates")

rssc.genome <- read_tsv('rssc.genome.tsv',col_names = "strains") %>% pull(strains)


anicluster <- fastani %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Genome, names_to = "Genome2", values_to = "ANI") %>% 
  group_by(Genome) %>% 
  filter(ANI>95) %>%
  filter(Genome %in% pull(metadata, "Genome") & Genome2 %in% pull(metadata, "Genome")) %>% 
  left_join(metadata) 
  # pull(`Level 4`) %>% 
  # unique()

  # write_csv("../Metadata/rssc_95ANI_fastbaps.csv")

```

```{r}
pwani <- fastani %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Genome, names_to = "Genome2", values_to = "ANI") %>% 
  filter(ANI > 95 & Genome != Genome2)



dist_g <- pwani %>% 
  igraph::graph_from_data_frame(., directed = F)


comps <- igraph::components(dist_g)

members <- comps$membership %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("genome1") %>% 
  rename("cluster"= ".")

members %>% 
  pull(cluster) %>% 
  unique()
```


```{r}

anicluster <- read_csv("<PROJECT_ROOT>/Results/Network/ANIclusterNX/RSSC_ANI95_nx_components_network.csv")


```


```{r}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)

```


```{r}

anigraph <- graph_from_data_frame(anicluster, directed = F)

E(anigraph)$weight <- anicluster$ANI

anigraph
```
